contentList.content: Sworn to spare, never to slay. Characters within [1] of you are <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KNOCKED_OUT">Knocked Out</LSTag> instead of dying.
Doesn't affect undead, constructs, inanimate objects, dead creatures, or anything immune to being knocked out.

Your oath stays the killing blow. Characters within [1] of you are Knocked Out instead of dying.

Doesn't affect undead, constructs, inanimate objects, dead creatures, or anything immune to being knocked out.
<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="NON_LETHAL">Pacifist's Vow</LSTag> holds back the killing blow. This character will be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KNOCKED_OUT">Knocked Out</LSTag> instead of dying.
